name: Alpha
notes: The 25th monster: a random species (never the player's), in its rare Alpha colors with a golden crown and sparkles. Its level grows while it sleeps: it starts each run at level 4 and gains 1 at every whole minute on the run clock (5 at 1:00, 6 at 2:00 ... up to 14 at 10:00), until the other 24 have fainted and it wakes; then its level stays (the game variable boss_level, raised by the player's run clock). 180 HP at any level, its move 1 hits 1.5x harder (its moves 2 and 3 at normal power: a 40-power move 3 hits for 58 at level 4 up to 118 at level 14, and a super-effective one for 87 up to 177, so from level 10 up a super-effective move 3 can knock out a full-HP player in one blow), and it gives 60 XP. It sleeps in the stone circle of the south-east clearing until the other 24 have fainted, then wakes with a roar for the final fight: the run music stops under the roar and, 40 ticks later, the boss theme (mus_boss) starts and plays until the run ends (unless the run already ended in those 40 ticks).Unlike the other wild monsters it uses all 3 of its species' moves: it attacks every 3.3 s, and each attack is its move 3 (R) when that has recharged, else its move 2 (B), else its move 1 (A). Moves 2 and 3 recharge twice as slowly as the player's (move 2: 20 s; move 3: 20-120 s depending on the move) and are both ready when it wakes, so the fight opens with its move 3, then its move 2. While it flies (Gustling's Fly) only its shadow shows. Like the others it keeps 1 tile of room from other wild monsters. Like every wild monster it blinks red 3 times when hit. When it comes into view (its whole body at least 32 px inside the screen, below the top HUD panel) its level shows over its head in cyan (LV4 to LV14) for 3 s; the tag vanishes the moment a move reaches it. After more than 5 s out of that view it counts as unseen again, so coming back shows the tag again. The tag sits above its crown.
